canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 4,678 FHA applications Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na acted on ended without a credit decision: 22.1% withdrawn by the applicant and 13.0% closed for incompleteness.

required_qualifiers.population: Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na FHA applications acted on (actions 1-5: originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, closed for incompleteness; purchased loans and preapproval requests excluded; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate; process, market, applicant pool and reporting practice are not separable in the record

does_not_establish: that Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na's process causes applicants to withdraw, or that its applicants cause files to close
that Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na is better or worse than another lender for a given applicant
Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na discriminates or violates law
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
